prompts: Find my workflows that handle support requests.
Build a draft workflow that records a sample form submission.
Generate a product image with Nano Banana using my Gateway credits.
Scrape this page with Firecrawl and summarize it.
requirements: An n8n account with instance-level MCP access enabled.
Gateway credits on the instance for models, image and video generation, web search and scraping, and PDF tools.
limitations: Workflow access follows the permissions and MCP settings in your n8n instance.
Publishing and running a workflow can change other services.
Gateway tools and models spend the instance's Gateway credits.
